Macrons

Consonantal i

Kitchen, meals & drinks

peel verb

remove the rind

classical

dēcorticō, dēcorticāre

verb, first conjugation

strip the bark or peel

Applied here to fruit. No unattested perfect is supplied.

Other words

  • cutem resecāre — peel, literally “cut off the skin”

    also used · modern · Traupman 72

    Used alongside dēcorticāre.

See also peel, peeler, skin, trim.

SourcesLewis & Short: decortico
